exposure: experience of complications (pain abdomen, bleeding, discharge per vaginum)
outcome: not opting for any family planning method after discontinuation
cohort: The study enrolled 916 recent PPIUD adopter women from 100 public healthcare facilities in Odisha and Chhattisgarh, India.
finding: PPIUD continuation rates were 88.7% at 6 weeks, 74.8% at 6 months, and 60.1% at one year, with higher education and experience of complications being associated with PPIUD removal.
